title: Inspecting rows: head, tail, and sample
description: Course activity for Chapter 1 EDA: compare the rows that DataFrame.head(), DataFrame.tail(), and DataFrame.sample() return from the curated ABIDE-II table, and see how many acquisition sites and missing cells each view contains.
instructions: Choose head(), tail(), or sample(), and set how many rows to show. Empty cells are missing values, not errors. Watch the summary line: how many acquisition sites appear, and how many cells are missing, in each view?
reflectionPrompts: Switch between head() and tail() without changing the row count. Does the set of acquisition sites change?
Switch to sample(). How many sites appear now, and how does the number of missing cells compare with head() and tail()?
